title: Harkerware Currier Ives 6 1/4" Gold Trim Plate “The Old Homestead In Winter” USA
descriptionText: The Harkerware Currier Ives 6 1/4" Gold Trim Plate "The Old Homestead In Winter" is a vintage collector's item featuring a landscape and building pattern in a beige color. Made in the United States in the Mid 20th Century, this round plate with a diameter of 6.5 inches is part of the Currier & Ives product line and weighs 6.2 ounces. Its stackable design and Colonial style make it a perfect addition to any American-themed decor collection, depicting the theme of an old homestead in winter.
